messages:
Alex R: Quick follow-up from yesterday's P99 degrade - I think our postmortem follow-up process needs clearer timelines and owner SLAs. Proposing: short timeline template, comms cadence, explicit remediation owners, monthly IC rotation. Thoughts?

Maya P: +1. We keep losing sight of 30/60/90 items. Template would help.

Sam K: Agree. Also noting recurring pattern: cache thundering surfaced in 3 incidents this quarter. Need to prioritize recurring patterns in tracker.

Jin W: Draft timeline:
- Day 0-1: Incident summary + initial comms (IC)
- Day 2-7: Postmortem draft + RCA (owners assigned)
- Day 8-14: Action items triaged + owners + ETA
- Day 30/60/90: Check-ins and status updates
Recommend owner + owner-SLA per action (e.g., 14 days for high-sev; 60 days for infra-medium).

Liz H: Comms cadence idea: create incident channel on start -> status every 30m while active -> postmortem published within 72h -> weekly updates for open remediations. Can we automate reminders? :robot_face:

OncallBot: reminder created: postmortem-draft-check in 48h for thread 1768123457.

Alex R: Automation yes. Also want a simple tracker with columns: owner, due_date, status, SLA, priority, recurring_pattern + link to playbook. Sam, can you add recurring-pattern column?

Sam K: Will do. I'll make a sheet and add columns: owner, priority, SLA, due_date, status, recurring_pattern. Will post link.

Maya P: For IC rotation: monthly is fine. Publish rotation calendar + backups. Add a postmortem reviewer role separate from IC for quality checks.

Jin W: +1 on reviewer. Also action-item template so folks don't write vague tasks. Example: `owner: jin.w; action: add circuit-breaker to model pool; due: 2026-05-14; priority: high; acceptance: perf regress <5% and 24h canary`

Liz H: Policy idea: If an issue appears 2x in 30 days or 3x in 90 days, auto-escalate to recurring-problem path with required remediation plan in 30 days.

Alex R: Make escalation automatic in tracker and add recurring-incident review to monthly reliability sync.

Maya P: Actions from thread:
- Sam: create tracker and include recurring_pattern column (due EOD Thu)
- Jin: draft timeline + action template (due Mon)
- Liz: automation checklist + Slack workflow proposal (due Wed)
- Alex: rotation calendar + reviewer role doc (due Fri)

Sam K: Assigned. Sheet will be shared.

OncallBot: Created recurring-remediation label for tracker and scheduled weekly reminders for open actions.

Alex R: Good plan. Pilot for two months after templates + tracker ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
